name: Advance Syntex Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1989, Advance Syntex Ltd is
 in the business of manufacturing and trading 
 of Metallic yarn, lacquer-coated aluminum metalized polyester film, glitter powder 
and allied other products[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
ASL is in the manufacturing and supplying an array of Polyester Film, Textile Glitter Powder, Glitter Powder, Hot Stamping Foils, Children 
 Craft Kit, etc. in India and abroad

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
